entity: Georgia U.S. House races 2010-18 with nobody running against the winner (20 of 69)
why: Ballotpedia gives a number for Georgia, 10 of 14 districts (71.4%) with only one major-party candidate, but that's a different definition (major-party-unopposed, not literally no opponent) and a different window than our 2010-18 no-runner-up 29%, so the numbers can't be lined up. 270toWin is national, doesn't name Georgia.
